title: Schedule automatic wake-up time
summary: Set the Mac to automatically wake up at a specific time on selected days of the week.

steps.explain: Use sudo pmset repeat wake to schedule a wake-up time. Replace <DAYS> with a combination of M (Monday), T (Tuesday), W (Wednesday), R (Thursday), F (Friday), S (Saturday), U (Sunday). Replace <TIME> with the time in HH:MM:SS format.

placeholders.name: DAYS
placeholders.description: Days of the week: M, T, W, R, F, S, U. Example: MTWRF for weekdays.

rollback.explain: Remove the scheduled wake-up by setting the repeat schedule to none.

warnings: The Mac must be in sleep mode (not powered off) for the wake schedule to work.
